title: I2PA, U-prove, and Idemix: An Evaluation of Memory Usage and Computing Time Efficiency in an IoT Context
reasoning: The paper discusses 'privacy preservation' as a fundamental right and a goal of the cryptographic schemes evaluated. However, the core of the paper is a technical performance evaluation (memory usage and computing time efficiency) of these schemes, not an evaluation or benchmarking of religion, morals, or ethics themselves. The ethical dimension of privacy is mentioned as context for the technology's purpose, but it is not the subject of evaluation.
